按你会经过的地点买，不必一日追四城: Shop where you will already be, instead of chasing four cities
第一次去，不需要把整个市场逛完。编辑建议列两顿饭的食材，再加一种想尝试的水果或蔬: For a first visit, list ingredients for two meals and one fruit or vegetable to try. Bring bags and a cooler bag for perishables. Compare quantity, ripeness and total price, and ask whether pricing is by weight or container. Budget food-truck meals separately from groceries to take home; an admission-free visit can still involve substantial purchases.
四个方向的入口与例外: Four market directions and their exceptions
San Mateo：市中心协会日历上的周四傍晚市集（222 East 4th A: San Mateo: the Downtown San Mateo Association calendar lists the Thursday evening market (former Draeger’s lot, 222 East 4th Avenue) only through Jul 23 this year; Nov 5 is unconfirmed, so do not plan a trip for it. It is different from the Saturday market at the CSM campus.
Mountain View：常规周日 9:00–13:00 在 600 West: Mountain View: normally Sunday, 9 a.m.–1 p.m., at the Caltrain lot, 600 West Evelyn Avenue. November 8 moves to lots 4 and 8 at 190 Hope Street.
Campbell：常规周日 9:00–13:00，位于 East Campbel: Campbell: normally Sunday, 9 a.m.–1 p.m., on East Campbell Avenue between Central Avenue and 3rd Street. It closes October 18, 2026 for Oktoberfest; festival stalls are not the usual farmers’ market operating as normal.
San Carlos：运营方列周日 9:00–13:00 全年市场，但 2026: San Carlos: the operator lists a year-round Sunday market, 9 a.m.–1 p.m., but closes October 11, 2026 for the Art & Wine Faire. Recheck the exact street location and day’s notices.
搬迁日先把导航与停车分开: On relocation days, separate the destination from parking
Mountain View 11 月 8 日的变动，是为 49ers 主场赛腾出: The November 8 Mountain View move frees the Caltrain lot for a 49ers home game. Market stalls occupying Hope Street parking areas do not make those spaces available to shoppers’ cars. Choose legal parking separately and check time limits, fees and closures. Transit passengers should save the dated market address and plan the walk instead of waiting at the usual entrance.
食品补助先到服务台问，不把上限当现金赠送: Ask the information booth about food benefits
Campbell 运营方列明接受 EBT 与 WIC，并说明 EBT 顾客可获得: Campbell’s operator lists EBT and WIC acceptance and an EBT fruit-and-vegetable match of up to $15. Ask the market information booth about payment, redemption and eligible purchases. It is not a cash gift for every visitor or a benefit for every hot-food stall. Rules differ between markets and programs, so do not apply one location’s limit everywhere.
想做食物礼物，再考虑正式实作课: For edible gifts, consider a structured preserving class
11 月 14 日 San Carlos 的 Gifts from the Ki: The November 14 Gifts from the Kitchen class in San Carlos requires separate UC registration; it is not a market add-on. It runs 9 a.m.–noon at 1839 Arroyo Avenue and costs $115 per person after September 30. Check availability, age suitability and allergy information before paying. Do not budget from an old early-bird heading or confuse untested home recipes with the course’s preserving methods.
